signals.headline: Arrow Midstream Acquires HD5 Assets, Announces HD5 Founder as President
signals.summary: HOUSTON, Texas — Arrow Midstream LLC announced that, together with an affiliate, the company has acquired substantially all of the assets used in HD5 Transport, LLC’s trucking operations, expanding Arrow’s liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) transportation platform.
